holidays.name: National Tortilla Chip Day
holidays.description: A day to honor the humble, crunchy triangle that makes salsa, guacamole, and queso possible. Grab a bag, build a nacho tower, and dip with pride.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial food observance of unclear origin. It has become a fixture on snack-holiday calendars as a salute to the crispy corn classic.
holidays.funFact: Tortilla chips grew out of a clever way to use up misshapen or leftover tortillas. Cutting them into wedges and frying them turned scraps into one of the world's favorite snacks.

holidays.name: World Bartender Day
holidays.description: A toast to the people who shake, stir, and pour, and who also listen to your stories. Celebrate by tipping well, trying a new cocktail, or thanking your favorite barkeep.
holidays.origin: The day was created in 2018 by The Perfect Blend, a cocktail competition in Australia and New Zealand. It was meant to bring bartenders together and celebrate one of the world's oldest professions.
holidays.funFact: Bartending is often called one of the oldest professions, with roots in ancient taverns. The day itself is quite young and began Down Under.
